title: credit
description: A tenant-level or invoice-level credit (issue #93), e.g. a goodwill credit or an overpayment carried forward. `invoice_id` is null for an unapplied account-level credit. `amount_minor` is always non-negative; a credit only ever reduces what is owed, applied through `lib/omes/py/jobs/ledger.py`'s `compute_totals()`, never by mutating a line directly.
